commit 62dbd760bd1c93a2c1a05ef472f69546975f70be
Author: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Date:   Wed Aug 19 02:35:48 2026 +0000

    Fix the two remaining JDK 11 compiler-path failures
    
    Both are 2012-era assumptions about the JDK's internals that moved:
    
    1. InstantiatingClassloader's ClassLoadChecker delegates sun.* to the
       system loader but predates JDK 9's move of reflection's generated
       accessors to jdk.internal.reflect. On JDK 11, Constructor.newInstance
       (used by Utility.makeFortressException, e.g. for DivisionByZero)
       defines its magic accessor with the Fortress classloader as defining
       loader, and superclass resolution of MagicAccessorImpl re-entered
